auth0Info.title: Set up EarthRanger Identity
auth0Info.intro: EarthRanger is moving to a simpler, more secure way to sign in, called EarthRanger Identity.
auth0Info.signInPrompt: If you already have EarthRanger Identity, select Sign in with email below.
auth0Info.convertPrompt: First time using EarthRanger Identity? You'll first need to convert your existing account using the username and password you use today.
auth0Info.helpText: Questions? Reach out to your site admin.
